profile.secretHint: Leave empty to be asked each time you connect. If entered, it is encrypted with the master password and stored on this PC.

profile.forwardsHint:
Local: connects a port on this PC to the target address as seen from the server. e.g. listen port 8080 → localhost:80
Remote: connects a port on the server to the target address as seen from this PC. e.g. listen port 9000 → localhost:3000
Only works while the tab is open.
If you turn on 'Allow connections from all addresses', other PCs on the same network can connect to this port too.

vault.heading: Saved passwords
vault.none: No master password yet. You set one the first time you save a password in a profile.
vault.reset: Delete all (if you forgot the master password)
vault.resetConfirm: This deletes all saved passwords and the master password. It cannot be undone. Continue?
vault.resetDone: All saved passwords were deleted. You will set a new master password the next time you save one
vault.hint: The master password is not stored anywhere. You are asked once, the first time a saved password is needed after the app starts, and it is remembered until the app closes. They are stored in secrets.json next to the executable.

general.heading: General
general.hint: Scrollback is kept in memory per tab, 1,000 to 50,000 lines (default 10,000). Lowering it drops the older lines right away.
general.keepaliveHint: 0 turns it off. When the server is quiet, a signal is sent at this interval to stop the connection from being dropped; after 3 unanswered signals the connection is closed. Use {min} seconds or more. Applies to tabs you connect from now on.

font.heading: Terminal font
font.hint: You can also type a font name that is not in the list. A font that is not installed falls back to the default font. Size is 8 to 32.

editor.heading: SFTP file editor
editor.placeholder: Empty = the Windows default edit program
editor.hint: Files you edit from the SFTP list (right-click) open in this program. If empty, Windows opens the program registered for 'edit' of that file type, or Notepad if there is none (files such as .bat are only opened for editing, never run). Example: C:\Program Files\Notepad++\notepad++.exe
editor.dblclick: Double-click on a file (folders always open)
editor.dblEdit: Edit only if editable (do nothing otherwise)

ai.heading: AI assistant (OpenAI-compatible)
ai.modelPlaceholder: Model name provided by the server
ai.systemPlaceholder: e.g. Always answer in English and tell me when sudo is needed
ai.hint: Enter the address of a server that provides an OpenAI-compatible API (/v1/chat/completions). Ending at /v1 is enough. The API key is stored as plain text in settings.json, so do not enter it on a shared PC. Your conversation and any attached terminal output are sent to this server. The AI only suggests commands; you run them yourself (Enter).
ai.log: Save the conversation to files in the logs folder
ai.logHint: When on, one file per day (ai-DATE.jsonl) is written to the logs folder next to the program, one line per question, answer and command typed in with [Type into terminal]. Attached terminal output is recorded after passwords and the like are masked. Files are not deleted automatically, so clean them up yourself when needed.
ai.exec: Allow running commands on the SSH server
ai.execConfirm:
This lets the AI run commands directly on the connected SSH server.

Read-only commands (ls, cat, df, etc.) run immediately and the result is passed to the AI. Other commands ask for your approval each time, and dangerous commands are refused. Command output (with passwords and the like masked) is sent to the AI server.

Allow it?
ai.execHint: Works on SSH tabs only. If your server supports tool calling, turn on "Server supports tool calling"; otherwise the AI asks for commands with ```run code blocks. Every command run is always recorded in audit-DATE.jsonl in the logs folder. The app's command check is not a perfect security boundary, so connecting with a permission-restricted account on the server is the safest.

icon.urlHint: Downloads a png, jpg, gif, webp or ico image (max 1 MB, no SVG) and saves it in the icons folder next to this program.

ai.notConfigured: Set the server URL and model name first.
ai.tip: Ask when you need a command. The AI only suggests commands; you run them yourself (Enter). Select output in the terminal by dragging, then press [Attach selection] to ask about it.
ai.placeholder: Type a question (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line, /help for commands)
ai.noSelection: Select the output to attach in the terminal first
ai.noOutput: There is no output to attach
ai.previewTitle: Attachment (this text is sent after passwords and the like are masked)
ai.autoScreenConfirm: When on, the recent output of the terminal you are viewing (last {lines} lines) is sent to the server with every question. Passwords and the like are masked, but not perfectly. Turn it on?
ai.explainPrompt: Please explain the following terminal output. If it is an error, tell me the cause and how to fix it.
ai.emptyAnswer: The AI sent no answer about the results. Ask it to report the results again.
ai.execNoSsh: Commands can run on SSH tabs only. Suggesting only this time.
ai.maxSteps: Stopped after reaching the step limit ({n}) for one question. Ask again to continue.
ai.cmdScreen: Turn automatic screen inclusion on or off (/screen on, /screen off)
